body.text: The primary function of the PHT is to transport heat from the reactor core to the IHT.
body.anchor: The primary function of the PHT is to transport heat from the reactor core

body.text: A safety-significant function is to keep primary sodium temperatures within limits that preclude damage to the reactor, fuel, or internals.
body.anchor: maintain primary sodium temperatures within design limits

body.text: The PHT includes two IHXs, two PSPs, and three sodium pools inside the RV. PSP flanges, IHX flanges, and PSP motors are above the reactor head.
body.anchor: The PSP flanges, IHX flanges, and PSP motors are located above the reactor head

body.text: PSP isolation circuit breakers are in the Nuclear Island Control Building, and the PSP adjustable speed drives are in the Nuclear Island Electrical Building.
body.anchor: The PSP adjustable speed drives are located in the Nuclear Island Electrical Building

body.text: The PSPs are two identical vertical centrifugal pumps on opposite sides of the RV. They draw from the cold pool and discharge into the core inlet plenum.
body.anchor: The PSPs are two identical vertically-oriented centrifugal pumps

body.text: The pump shaft is sealed near the support flange to prevent sodium and cover gas leakage, and the seal also limits air and moisture leakage into the RV.
body.anchor: The seal also limits leakage of both air and moisture into the RV

body.text: The IHXs are vertical, counter-flow, single-pass, straight-tube heat exchangers with a floating lower head.
body.anchor: The IHXs are vertical, counter-flow, single-pass, straight-tube type heat exchangers

body.text: Primary sodium is on the shell side and intermediate sodium is on the tube side.
body.anchor: Flow in the IHX includes the primary sodium on the shell side and the intermediate sodium on the tube side

body.text: During normal operation, in Modes 1, 2, 3, and 4, the PSPs drive flow from the cold pool, through the core to the hot pool, and through the IHX to the cold pool.
body.anchor: in all modes of operation (Modes 1, 2, 3, and 4), the PSPs provide motive force

body.text: The PSPs are the only PHT components that need operator inputs to change state in normal operation.

body.text: After a LOOP, pumps go to minimum flow if power returns from the standby diesel generators. If not, flow reduces to natural circulation rates.

title: Primary Heat Transport System
subject: PHT
intro: The PHT moves core heat to the intermediate loops. It has two pumps, two heat exchangers, and three sodium pools, and it keeps working by natural circulation when the pumps stop.
